versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

ai-podcast-voiceover 0.1.6

- Added support for generating and confirming a music bed as a separate, paid step; music bed work is now handled within the package.
- Updated workflow to present speech and music production cards separately; approvals are no longer interchangeable.
- Clarified distinction between solo-host audio delivery and multi-host or assembled productions, with new routing guidance.
- Expanded SKILL.md documentation to detail music bed handling, strict card separation, and production confirmation process.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
Publish the reviewed AI Podcast Voiceover workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
